Rivera advises Fisk about optics and how they would be essential for how his anti-vigilante platform will go down. Fisk works to build himself a reputation of the Mayor who fixes issues without needless bureaucracy, but learns from BB Urich that Phil Gallo is opposing him, which signs trouble for Fisk's influence on the police. Gallo intends to resign from his position as the Commissioner in protest, but Fisk blackmails him into staying and working under him.
Catching Nicky Torres being assaulted by Connor Powell and Kel Shanahan, Hector Ayala intervenes to save Torres, resulting in Shanahan accidentally dying. Powell reveals that they were police officers and take Ayala into custody, charging him with a murder of Shanahan, so Murdock & McDuffie take on his defense. While Murdock and McDuffie prepare for the case, Cherry discovers Ayala is actually a masked vigilante, known as White Tiger. Murdock manages to convince Jerry Cooper to keep the truth about Ayala out of the court proceedings to avoid bias within the jury.
As their marriage deteriorates, Wilson and Vanessa approach Glenn for couple therapy to work out their issue and preserve their marriage. Vanessa is unsure on how to feel about Wilson's return after Maya Lopez almost killed him, while Wilson is afraid that they are drifting apart from each other. Moreover, the tensions within the Five Families result in a homicide that puts Wilson's Red Hook Port project in a bind. Vanessa scrambles to preserve the peace by putting pressure onto Luca, while Wilson thinks that chaos would be more beneficial in the long run, although Vanessa views that as Wilson trying to punish her for Adam.
The day before the proceedings, Murdock tails Powell and finds out that he is looking for Torres to eliminate the witness in the Ayala case. Murdock manages to get to Torres first and stashes him away, before getting into a violent altercation with Powell, but manages to force him into keeping quiet about that. During the trial, Powell testifies that Ayala attacked him and Shanahan unprovoked, but Murdock accuses him of lying and prepares to bring Torres in to testify. Despite Powell's attempts to intervene, Cherry manages to bring Torres but he commits perjury to protect Powell, being pressured by the police.
As Murdock & McDuffie lose a vital part of their defense strategy, Murdock calls Ayala to the stand and suddenly outs him as White Tiger. Cooper and Benjamin Hochberg confront him, as he was the one who asked to keep it out of the proceedings, but the trial continues on. With that, Murdock and McDuffie submit reports and testimonies from the people that were saved by White Tiger, which sways the jury and Ayala is proclaimed not guilty. In thw interview with Urich, Fisk calls Ayala's verdict a miscarriage of justice and an indication why his anti-vigilante platform is necessary to help the city.
In the wake of his acquittal, Ayala decides to continue being White Tiger, but gets shot and killed by an unidentified gunman wearing a Punisher Vest. Angela Del Toro, Ayala's niece, is devastated at the loss of her uncle and blames the NYPD for killing him due to his victory in court. Murdock comforts Del Toro, telling her to have faith that Ayala's killer would be found soon.
During a party, Blake gets drunk and accidentally reveals to Urich that Fisk is working on a recycling project that circumvents the contracts with the garbage worker union. Urich publishes the story on The BB Report, which throws the entirety of Fisk's office into disarray. Fisk is furious and despite Rivera's warnings to stay low, Blake steps forward and takes responsibility for his blunder. Blake makes it clear that no matter what punishment he is going to receive, he will remain Fisk's steadfast supporter no matter what. Moved by Blake's sincere loyalty, Fisk decides to not punish him and keep him in his office, while warning him that further mistakes would not be tolerated.
Murdock takes on a defense of Leroy Bradford, a homeless man accused of stealing some caramel corn from a bodega, with all evidence pointing at him being guilty. Bradford insists on getting probation, which Murdock finds difficult due to Bradford being a repeat offender. At the precinct, Murdock gets to confront Powell and accuses him of killing Ayala, but Powell claims to not be involved, which Murdock verifies as truth. Murdock manages to reduce Bradford's sentence, but it is not enough for him, which causes Murdock to get angry and lash out. Bradford, however, opens up on how the system has been treating him, driving him into starvation and homelessness, so Murdock relents and empathizes with him.
The Fisks continue their therapy sessions with Glenn and the topic of Vanessa's affair gets brought up. Vanessa argues that she was left all alone and did not know if Wilson would return to her, while he feels betrayed and refuses to participate in the conversation. Glenn is worried that Vanessa might be unsafe with Wilson, which he catches onto fairly soon. Wilson talks to Vanessa about his father and the lessons he learned from him, while saying that Vanessa has changed into something even more extraordinary.
Murdock ends up coming to the place where Ayala was killed and investigates, discovered a bullet casing with a signature skull insignia on it. He pays a visit to Frank Castle to talk about it, suggesting that Ayala was killed by one of the police officers who idolize Punisher's brutality. However, the conversation gets heated soon enough, as Castle presses on Murdock's anger and guilt that he is trying to suppress, linking it to Nelson's death. Despite his attempts to deny it, Murdock admits that it destroys him, but he willingly let the system handle Poindexter, which Castle views as not being enough. Airing his grievances with the system to Glenn, Murdock decides to pick up his old Billy Club and starts training again.
On the St. Patrick's day, Luca sends Devlin and his associates to rob New York Mutual Bank and steal a valuable diamond to pay off his fine over the Red Hook Port shootings. Murdock, who has been in the bank to talk about the loan with Yusuf Khan, finds out and joins the hostages to save them from the inside. Working together with Khan, Murdock manages to work out Devlin's intentions, while the NYPD surrounds the bank and prepares for the attack. Murdock manages to successfully take down the robbers and recover the diamond, becoming friends with Khan.
Fisk's position as the Mayor gets complicated from multiple sides, including his Red Hook Port Revitalization Project, Luca's insolence and the emergence of a serial killer. An artist, known as Muse, has been kidnapping and killing people, using their blood in his murals he is painting across the city. Fisk mobilizes Gallo and the NYPD to handle Muse, but Fisk's decision to keep the information on Muse a secret results in even more victims. Meanwhile, Fisk works to secure funding for his Red Hook Port project, but it becomes clear that against the New York elite, Fisk is in a much weaker position than he is used to.
Murdock gets approached by Del Toro, who wants to continue Ayala's investigation into kidnappings in the city, but gets very frustrated when Murdock refuses to help. Del Toro ends up looking into it on her own, and gets kidnapped by Muse, who intends to kill her and use her for his next artwork. Still thinking about Del Toro's words, Murdock makes a decision to become Daredevil once again and after being told that Del Toro disappeared, he intervenes. Daredevil manages to find Del Toro inside Muse's lair and fights him, saving Del Toro and forcing Muse to retreat.
As the NYPD does not progress in the Muse investigation, Fisk proposes the foundation of the Anti-Vigilante Task Force, consisting of the most problematic NYPD officers under his command. Despite the pushback from Gallo, Fisk secures the support from various officers like Powell and Cole North, recruiting them into the AVTF. That night, he goes down to the dungeon where he has been secretly keeping Adam prisoner and brutally beats him down, releasing his pent-up rage. Later, Fisk gets updated on Del Toro surviving Muse's attack and the return of Daredevil, which does not please Fisk, but Cashman warns him to stay smart about it.
Despite Cherry trying to talk him out of taking more risks, Murdock is adamant on using Del Toro's lead to bring Muse down, now that he has been found and is liable to make a mistake. As the NYPD investigates Muse's lair, Daredevil finds numerous sketches depicting Glenn's face on them, realizing that she must be Muse's target. Angie Kim, who has been investigating Muse, makes a breakthrough and finds out that Muse's true identity is Bastian Cooper. Fisk appreciates Kim's work but dismisses her and lets the AVTF to work on taking Cooper down.
Cooper comes to a therapy session with Glenn, during which he admits to his mental struggles and reveals to Glenn that he is Muse. He captures Glenn and prepares to kill her for his ultimate artwork, ranting about his desire to be seen and his obsession with Glenn and her work. Before Muse gets to kill Glenn, Daredevil confronts him and the two fight again, while the AVTF surrounds the buildings. Daredevil manages to defeat Muse and Glenn shoots him dead, before passing away from the blood loss, while Daredevil stabilizes her before she is hospitalized.
As the NYPD investigates the scene of Muse's death, Fisk decides to alter the narrative and give all credit for stopping muse to the AVTF. To achieve that, Fisk orders Blake to pressure Urich into lying in her report, despite Daredevil's involvement being rather obvious. Fisk's plan succeeds and the mass media report that Muse has been taken down by the AVTF, which Fisk uses to strengthen his influence and the stance of his anti-vigilante platform.
Meanwhile, Luca tries to meet with Vanessa behind Wilson's back and convince her that Wilson's current conduct is only hurting the Five Families and he needs to be removed. He tries to convince Vanessa to cooperate with him and take control in full, despite Vanessa being the one who forced the restitution on him. Vanessa entertains Luca's proposal and even gives him a location where Wilson would be alone for Luca to kill. However, it turns out to be a trap and Luca gets killed by Cashman, as Vanessa never intended to betray her husband.
Later, Wilson brings Vanessa over to his dungeon, revealing to her that he has been keeping Adam prisoner and abusing him for some time. While Adam pleads and begs for them to let him out, Wilson addresses Vanessa and acknowledges his shortcoming as a husband, him keeping a secret from her, and says that he cannot go on without her. Wilson lets Vanessa decide Adam's fate and after brief hesitation, Vanessa decides that Adam cannot be released. She personally murders him and embraces Wilson, as the two rekindle their love for each other.
In response to her experience with Muse, Glenn reconsiders her stance on the vigilantes and decides that they are perpetuating violence, despite Murdock arguing that Daredevil saved her life. Cashman shows up there with Glenn's invitation to the Black & White Ball, organized by Fisk, and Murdock finds out that she has been working as their therapist. Murdock claims that Glenn should not trust Fisk, as he only wants to use Glenn to support his narrative, which she does not seem to be too opposed. As the two argue, Glenn suggests Murdock to accompany her to the ball if he is so concerned, but Murdock does have an answer for her.
Meeting with McDuffie, Murdock finds out that the Mayor's office moved Poindexter to a general population, and that Poindexter is asking for a meeting with him. As they are working on Thomas Madison 's case, who has been accused of fraud, Murdock finds out that he is lying and openly accuses him. McDuffie questions Murdock's outburst and whether she should have told him about Poindexter or not, asking what is happening with him. Murdock admits to McDuffie that he is frustrated that their work to uphold the law feels useless when all injustices keep piling on, while Fisk keeps amassing more and more support.
Fisk and his associates celebrate the success of their office, especially the AVTF, although Rivera views their excessive methods as liability. Fisk is unbothered and comments on the AVTF's good publicity, giving credits to Blake and the way he handled Urich's coverage of the events. He decides to appoint Blake as a Deputy Mayor for Communications, and although Rivera tries to interject, Fisk is certain that people like him are what the city needs.
Murdock meets with Josie at her closed bar, where he also gets found by Cherry, who was sent by McDuffie to look after Murdock. As they talk, Murdock questions if Poindexter's transfer was really a coincidence and thinks that they are missing something, although Cherry reminds him that Poindexter and Fisk not being connected at the time was proven. However, Murdock then finds out from Josie that Nelson has been celebrating an early victory in the Cafaro case the night he was killed. Murdock realizes that Nelson has been involved in something serious and somebody wanted to silence him before the trial.
Murdock comes to Rikers Island and meets with Poindexter, demanding him to tell if he has been hired by Fisk to kill Nelson. Poindexter acts elusive and avoids the answer, only saying that now that he is in a general population, he is in constant danger. He says that he will only divulge any information if Murdock represents him and gets him out of jail, which infuriates Murdock. He smashes Poindexter's head against the wall and leaves, but Poindexter uses it to his advantage and escapes from prison.
During the Black & White Ball at Gracie Mansion, Wilson pressures the attending elites into supporting his redevelopment project, notably threatening Jack Duquesne to out him as a vigilante. Glenn, still upset at Murdock bailing on her, talks to Vanessa and finds out that she and Wilson already resolved their issue and no longer need therapy. A journalist, disguised as a waiter tries to snoop around, so Wilson sends Powell and the AVTF after him, as they assault and harm the journalist. Gallo attempts to stop them and threatens Powell, but he reveals that since the AVTF answers to the Mayor directly, Gallo has no authority over them.
Murdock eventually arrives at the ball, where Glenn voices her frustrations with him being distant, but Murdock is more invested into checking on Fisk. Urich talks to Blake about Fisk's behind-the-doors extortion and calls him out for corruption, but Blake does not side with her. Urich then approaches Gallo regarding the AVTF's violent and excessive conduct, while Gallo accuses her of falsely reporting Muse's situation in favor of Fisk. Gallo then tells her that Fisk was a prime suspect in the murder of Ben Urich, but Urich reveals that she knew and she is secretly working against Fisk, hoping that Gallo would support her.
Murdock overhears Vanessa being informed by Cashman about Poindexter's escape and her urge to talk to Wilson about something important. He realizes that Vanessa was the one who ordered Nelson's death, being in charge of Wilson's criminal empire at the time. He steals Vanessa for a dance and confronts her about that, but Vanessa seems unbothered and casually asks Murdock about the secret he keeps from Glenn. Wilson then has a dance with Glenn and alludes to her that Murdock might not be the man she thinks he is.
Poindexter passes through the security and infiltrates the mansion, initially intending to kill Vanessa, but instead targets Wilson. Murdock catches that and suddenly shields Wilson, taking a bullet for him and bleeding out in Glenn's arms, while the Fisks get evacuated. Poindexter goes into hiding, while Wilson talks to Vanessa and reveals that he has already known about her secretly working with Poindexter to kill Nelson. He comments on Vanessa's business with Red Hook Port, adding that now that he has all the power he needs, their income will increase tenfold.
Following his attempt to protect Fisk, Murdock recovers from a gunshot at Metro-General Hospital, where Glenn and McDuffie visit him. Although Glenn tries to get Murdock to rest and focus on his recovery, he seems unconcerned and only cares about the case that Nelson was working on and led to Vanessa having him killed.
Fisk orders the NYPD to seal off the whole city and crack down on all vigilantes, not just Poindexter, without any concern for protocols or due process. Gallo opposes him, calling Fisk's orders unlawful, while Rivera points out that sealing off the city is a sensitive issue and necessitates a significant threat to the people. Fisk then talks to Cashman about Murdock who is still recovering and decides that it would be better for Murdock to die, ordering Cashman to take him out.
Later, Fisk also orders Rivera to vet out every employee at his office who might not be on his side, so he could take care of them. Gallo approaches Rivera and talks to her about Fisk manipulating the events in the city to weaken the police and strengthen the AVTF under his command, making them his own militia. Gallo claims that they cannot let Fisk keep consolidating power unchecked and intends to go up the ladder to stop Fisk. He hopes that Rivera would support his cause, and while she says that she cannot act of line, Rivera would take Gallo's side.
Fisk engineers a massive city-wide blackout, plunging New York into chaos and looting, during which the AVTF kills several civilians and claims them to be vigilantes. Cashman arrives at the hospital to finish Murdock off, but Murdock slips away and makes it to his home, where Castle is waiting for him. As the AVTF team, led by North, closes in on their location, Daredevil and Punisher ambush them and take them all down. Punisher sees a skull on North's bullet casings and tells Daredevil that they found the one who killed Ayala. As North shows no remorse, Punisher insists on killing him, but Daredevil does not want to do that.
Their argument gets interrupted by a grenade, so Daredevil and Punisher have to escape from the explosion, before Page shows up and picks them up. Page reveals to Murdock that she asked Castle to keep him safe after Poindexter's escape and joins forces with him to find the truth about Nelson's death, while Castle decides to stay behind. Murdock and Page go to the warehouse where their old case files were kept and discover that Nelson found out about Red Hook Port being a free port, exempt from any tolls and tariffs. Murdock realizes that Nelson was about to use it in court to dismiss Cafaro's charges, which would reveal a loophole Vanessa was using to earn her money, which was why she had to silence Nelson. He also concludes that Wilson is intending to use Red Hook Port to build his own city-state and legitimize his crimes.
Using North's radio, Punisher finds the AVTF's base at Red Hook Port and goes there, massacring numerous AVTF officers before he gets taken down and captured. Powell talks to Punisher about how everyone in the task force admires him, offering him to join their ranks. Punisher feels insulted that Powell dared to imply that they understand him and harshly rejects Powell, which earns him a beating.
Despite her regrets, Rivera turns on Gallo and provides Fisk with a recording of his intentions to go up against Fisk and his office. In response, Fisk has the AVTF to deliver Gallo to Red Hook Port, presenting him as the one who failed the entire NYPD as a part of the broken system. Fisk then brutally murders Gallo in front of them, while proclaiming that he and the AVTF will keep New York safe no matter what. Meanwhile, Blake meets up with the New York City Council and blackmails them into supporting Fisk's Safer Streets Initiative.
Daredevil considers going after Fisk, but Page talks him out of it, as it would only result in Daredevil dying or killing someone. On the next day, Fisk appoints Glenn as his Commissioner of Mental Health and addresses the city, claiming that vigilantes were responsible for the blackout and chaos of the last night, which is why he officially outlaws vigilantism altogether. He then announces the Safer Streets Initiative, which gives the AVTF the highest authority and effectively puts New York City under martial law. Fisk also uses his dungeon as a makeshift prison for his detractors, including Duquesne and Castle, and celebrates his victory there with his wife.
Regrouping at Josie's Bar, Daredevil decides that Fisk has become too powerful, meaning he needs an army to bring him down. Daredevil and Page gather their allies, including Cherry, Kim and numerous dissenting NYPD officers, who refused to support Fisk's rule. Daredevil addresses them and rallies them up to fight together and reclaim their city from Fisk. At that time, Castle manages to trick an AVTF officer guarding him and escapes from Fisk's dungeon.

titulo: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special — Plot (wiki do MCU)
texto:
On Knowhere, Kraglin Obfonteri tells the Guardians of the Galaxy the story of how he and Peter Quill tried to celebrate Earth 's Christmas when Quill was still a kid. However, Yondu got mad and told them to cut it out. Obfonteri says that according to the Multi-Calendar, Christmas is coming but Nebula says that they have too much on their plate after buying Knowhere from the Collector and needing to rebuild it following Thanos' attack. Meanwhile, Quill gets approached by Bzermikitokolok who is researching Christmas and wrote a song about it but he ends up completely mischaracterizing it, to Quill's annoyance.
Mantis tells Drax the Destroyer that she wants to do something for Quill for Christmas, due to her secret that she is Ego 's child and, therefore, Quill's sister. Thinking about giving him an unforgettable Christmas present, Drax suggests that Quill's hero, Kevin Bacon, would be a perfect option, so they take the Bowie and fly to Earth. Walking throughout Los Angeles, Mantis and Drax get mistaken for cosplayers and earn a lot of money from tourists who wanted to take pictures with them.
Looking for Bacon, Mantis and Drax go to a club where they get wasted, before a bystander gives them a star tours booklet with Bacon's home address. They go to Bacon's house and try to take him as a present but Bacon says that he cannot help them. However, Mantis and Drax then break into his house, so a horrified Bacon calls the police and tries to run away. The police arrives but Mantis and Drax incapacitate the officers, before catching up to Bacon. Mantis uses her powers to put Bacon in a trance and convince him to go with them.
Back on the Bowie, Mantis and Drax ask Bacon about his adventures that Quill was talking about. However, they realize that Bacon is not a hero, but just an actor. They both get disgusted, believing that actors are horrible people and thinking that Quill's perception of Bacon was warped. Mantis uses her powers to get Bacon to act as an actual hero, so Quill would not be disappointed. With the help of other inhabitants, the Guardians decorate Knowhere for a Christmas party, which amazes Quill but he soon gets horrified when he finds out that his present is Bacon, kidnapped by Mantis and Drax.
Quill immediately tells Mantis to get Bacon out of the trance and promises to get him back home, although he still freaks out. Obfonteri then brings Bacon to the Bowie to transport him to Earth and explains that Mantis and the others simply wanted to do something nice for their friend on Christmas, who was always fascinated by Bacon. Bacon then decides to stay on Knowhere for a while and performs a song with Bzermikitokolok and the Knowheremen at the Christmas party, during which the Guardians exchange presents.
Quill asks Mantis why she would go to such lengths to make him happy and she tells him about Obfonteri's story about how Udonta ruined Christmas for him. Quill then tells Mantis the rest of the story: after calling off the party, Udonta found a toy troll Quill wanted to give him as a present, so Udonta gave him a present as well - his Quad Blasters. Mantis tells Quill that she wanted to do something special for Quill and admits that she is actually his sister. Surprised, Quill tells Mantis that it is the best present he could think of and the two embrace, wishing each other Merry Christmas.
Afterwards, Rocket and Cosmo decorate Groot like a Christmas tree. However, Groot gets tired and lowers his arms, dropping all decorations. Cosmo says that Groot ruined Christmas again and Rocket remarks that now they "need another special".

titulo: I Am Groot | Season 1 — Plot (wiki do MCU)
texto:
Groot goes on many adventures as a baby. Another tree steals his spot on the table, so he attacks it in hopes that he can get his spot back. Eventually the two tree's fall to the ground, breaking Groot's pot. He then emerges with feet and is able to run around. Later, he goes to a planet where he finds a tiny species called Grunds. He terrorizes them thinking he is being playful. Eventually, they attack him which scares the baby tree enough to fart a leaf. The Grunds thankfully eat it as the leaves are their source of food. A happy Groot gathers up more leaves for them, but doesn't watch where he is going. He steps on all of the Grunds, walking away as if nothing happened.
Groot wakes up in the Quadrant from a loud noise. He eventually finds that it was made by a shape shifting alien named Iwua. Groot has a dance off until he leads Iwua to the escape hatch and sends him into space. Another time, Groot is back on the Grunds' planet and finds a puddle. He takes a bath and finds out the mud helps him grow leaves. He makes various hairstyles, but is also very loud, annoying a pink alien bird. The bird has had enough and attacks Groot. Groot then realizes the mud is gone, so he cuts off all of the birds hair and uses it as a scarf.
Back on the Quadrant, Groot decides to make a picture of the Guardians of the Galaxy. He gathers up many things to use and eventually creates a bomb in hopes of getting glitter for his drawing. Rocket hears the explosion and investigates. He finds Groot, who shows him the drawing. Rocket forgives him, but another explosion is set off. Rocket falls into a crater, but Groot catches him.

titulo: I Am Groot | Season 2 — Plot (wiki do MCU)
texto:
Groot goes on many more adventures to various planets, causing tons of havoc where he goes. On Terma, Groot finds a Terma Baby Bird and begins to play with the bird until he ultimately gets annoyed by its constant pooping. Suddenly, the bird's siblings arrive and stampede over Groot to their mother, who carries the birds away. On the Quadrant, Groot plays with his video games non-stop until the battery dies. He begins searching for a spare battery only to find a Bionic Nose instead. Using a new sense of smell, he explores what many things smell like and secures his battery along the way. When he gets back to his room, he smells the odor he caused, but just takes the nose off instead of cleaning.
On Falligar, Groot enjoys his snow day while making a hot drink. Outside, he plays in the snow and accidentally creates a robotic snowman that starts reaking havoc. Groot eventually destroys the snowman before gling back to his drink. Back on the Quadrant, Groot finds an Intergalactic Ice Cream Truck and searches frantically to find a coin. When he finally gets it, he finds that the truck is gone. Groopt jumps in a pod and flies towards the truck, crashing into it in order to get the ice cream. This stunt lands him on the Nova Corps radar. On Drez-Lar, Groot finds the Seed of Drez-Lar, much to Watcher 's excitement. The Watcher becomes confused as Groot pays no attention to the seed and eventually destroys it and the temple it is housed in. Uatu then realizes that Groot is the prophecy that he read.

titulo: Marvel's Daredevil | Season 2 — Plot (wiki do MCU)
texto:
Ten years ago, Foggy Nelson and Matt Murdock go to a party. Murdock's attention immediately falls on a woman named Elektra. They start dating, but Elektra starts becoming a bad influence on him. Soon, they break into a man's house. Elektra reveals it is the man who had his father killed, Roscoe Sweeney. Murdock angrily starts to beat Sweeney while Elektra encourages him. However, he soon realizes how wrong he is and stops. When he turns around to call the police, Elektra is gone.
In the present, the Kitchen Irish hold a meeting to discuss the new transfer of power now that Wilson Fisk is put away. Suddenly, all but one are shot dead by The Punisher. The only survivor is Grotto, who quickly seeks help from Nelson and Murdock. They bring Grotto to a hospital. At Metro-General Hospital, Karen Page stays with Grotto, but they are attacked by the Punisher. Daredevil pursues the murderer and leads him away. The Punisher then shoots Daredevil in the head, but he is saved by his helmet. He is found later by Nelson. In his apartment, they argue over his vigilantism as Murdock bleeds from his forehead. After Nelson leaves, Murdock becomes disoriented, and temporarily loses his hearing. Meanwhile, Frank Castle AKA The Punisher, kills a store owner for trying to sell child pornography.
Samantha Reyes and Blake Tower meet with Nelson and Murdock to discuss a deal with Grotto to help them. They reluctantly agree. Later, Grotto is used to lure the Punisher. This plan wasn't shared with Nelson, Murdock, and Page, which angers them. Castle arrives to kill Grotto, but is stopped by Daredevil. The fight ends with the two falling through a building, but Castle manages to get up and take Daredevil. Later, Page decides to investigate Castle by herself.
Daredevil wakes up, chained to a chimney on the top of a building with a gun taped to his hand. He and Castle argue about morals in if it's right to kill people. Castle argues that everybody Daredevil puts in jail gets out a few months later and returns to crime. There's no end unless they are killed. The Punisher then brings Grotto to the rooftop and tries to force Daredevil to shoot Grotto. Instead, Daredevil uses the one bullet to break himself out of the chain to charge at Castle. Seeing Daredevil run towards him, Castle kills Grotto and then shoots the Dogs of Hell down below. He says "One batch, two batch, penny and dime" before he shoots. This causes the gang to charge up the building towards Castle. Daredevil knocks out Castle and defeats every single man going down the stairwell. When he goes back to get the Punisher, he is gone.
Nelson, Murdock, and Page attend Grotto's funeral, but are the only attendees. Castle sits in front of the Central Park Carousel and is attacked by the last Kitchen Irish members. He's taken to their hideout and tortured for information on the money stolen from the Irish during his sprees, he sends them into a trap, and breaks free during the outrage. He starts killing, but is heavily injured and doesn't expect to make it out, until Daredevil barges in. He agrees to help Castle if he doesn't kill. Murdock then takes the badly injured Castle to a graveyard where Castle monologues before being arrested. He explains that he repeats his "One batch, two batch" chant before he shoots because it was the favorite book of his daughter who was murdered at the carousel along with the rest of his family. Castle has been going around killing everyone involved in the murder. Brett Mahoney then arrives and arrests Castle, but not Daredevil, after he tells Mahoney to take the credit for the Punisher's arrest, to show the public that the police are justice in the city. Mahoney doesn't understand Daredevil's, but knows that he isn't the same as the Punisher. Later, Murdock and Page kiss in the rain. Murdock returns home smiling, but abruptly raises a knife. He then lowers it when he realizes it is Elektra.
Elektra offers Murdock a job to help her take down powerful individuals. Instead, Murdock berates her after he hasn't seen her in years. Meanwhile, Nelson enlists the help of ex-girlfriend, Marci Stahl for information to take down Reyes. Murdock goes out to dinner with Page, but leaves when he gets an urgent call from Elektra. He decides to meet with her. They are suddenly surrounded by Yakuza and go to suit up. They soon defeat the group.
The next morning, Nelson and Murdock meet the lawyer appointed by Reyes, and realize he's inexperienced and unable to defend Castle properly. Karen asks Nelson and Murdock to defend Castle, so they go to see Castle in the hospital to convince him to accept them as his lawyers. He angrily tells them off, but Page tells him that he won't find answers about his family's murder if he's dead. Castle agrees to their services, but will only answer their questions alone with Page. Later, Nelson suggests that Castle plead guilty so that he can get the best sentence. When the Judge, District Attorney, and a stenographer enter, he pleads not guilty, sending them into the Trial of the Century. Meanwhile, Murdock and Elektra enter a gala to get a ledger from Hirochi and Stan Gibson.
Murdock works on his opening statement for the trail. He then goes to fight with Elektra against another villainous group, the Hand. Murdock then stitches up Elektra's wounds as they talk. The next morning, he wakes up and realizes he's late to the trial. Therefore, Nelson has to make the opening statement. Murdock arrives late and apologizes to the angry Nelson. Gregory Tepper is called in for questioning about the autopsy reports of Castle's family. However, he admits to falsifying the reports after his family was threatened by a woman with a red mask whom Murdock realizes is Elektra. He tells Nelson what has been going on which causes his best friend to angrily storm out. After, Murdock angrily yells at Elektra, but after gaining his composure, joins her at Midland Circle. They look around for Hand ninjas and find a deep hole under the building.
The Daredevil and Elektra find Hand ninjas and fight them. Elektra gets stabbed, filling her blood with poison. Daredevil sense her dying and tries to get her out. Suddenly, Stick arrives and takes them back to Murdock's place. Stick works to heal her and finally does which pleases Murdock. However, Stick accidentally reveals that he knows Elektra. Stick then is forced to explain that he and Elektra are members of the Chaste who are a group that try to stop the Hand. Later, Page walks in to see Murdock, but sees a woman in his bed and angrily walks out.
At the courthouse, Murdock gives a speech about vigilantism and its necessity, supposedly to defend Castle's actions. During break, Murdock notices a guard talking to Castle. When the trial resumes, Castle goes on a rant, disrespecting everyone and claiming he loves killing. The two lawyers sit there in disbelief. Murdock returns to his home to find a Hand ninja who stabs him with a poison arrow. Murdock goes to attack, but realizes it is just a kid. Suddenly, Elektra comes from behind and kills him. Murdock sits there and starts feeling the effects of the poison.
Castle arrives on Rikers Island and meets with the man who the guard him about, Wilson Fisk. Fisk, who has gained power in the prison, greets Castle and tries to strike a deal. Castle kills the current kingpin of the jail, and Fisk will let him free. Castle goes and kills Dutton, but finds out that Fisk double crossed him. Fisk's men open the gates to all of the cells, sprinkling out all of the prisoners to fight Castle. Although bloody, Castle kills all of them and goes to kill Fisk. However, the two criminals strike a truce and Fisk lets him go.
Meanwhile, Murdock wakes up from his injuries and forces Elektra to leave because he is worried about how easily she killed the kid. Then, a still angry Nelson suggests that they close down the firm now that the trial is over, to which Murdock agrees. Daredevil then goes to track down Roxxon Corporation member, Stan Gibson, who knows that the Hand infiltrated Roxxon. Gibson explains that the Hand has his son, Daniel. They find his son in a facility, but see that he and other kids are victims of a blood farm. They are suddenly attacked by a ninja. Daredevil stumbles for a moment and then realizes the ninja is Nobu Yoshioka who had been killed months ago.
Mahoney arrives at the farm to find the kids and Gibson. They are brought to Metro-General Hospital where Claire Temple tends to them. Reyes meets with Nelson, Murdock, and Page to discuss the information she recently found. A drug dealer named, Blacksmith, was one of the people to kill Castle's family. Murdock hears something outside and knocks Page to the ground. Suddenly, bullets fly through the walls killing Reyes and injuring Nelson. Nelson is then taken to the hospital. Thinking it was Castle, Murdock visits Fisk in prison and accuses him of letting Castle go. Fisk then angrily slams Murdock onto the table, threatening him. Since Fisk controls the prison, nobody helps. Murdock the walks away, bloody. Castle walks into Page's apartment where she quickly raises her gun at him. He tells her that it wasn't him who killed Reyes. Bullets then fly through the wall at them, Castle saves Page which proves he didn't kill her. Page and Mitchell Ellison decide to visit Tepper's house to get information on a story. When they arrive, they see the place has been shot up and Tepper killed.
At the hospital, Nelson notices many grappling hooks getting thrown onto the side of the building, these being Hand ninjas. The blood farmed children all of the sudden stand up, brainwashed by the Hand. They kill a nurse and escape back to the Hand. The hospital decides to cover this event up which angers Temple enough to quit her job and move to Harlem. Daredevil finds Tower and asks for advice about Blacksmith. Tower suggests to start with Blacksmith's biggest competitor, Madame Gao. Gao tells Daredevil that the heroin he sells is sold on a ship. Daredevil arrives at the ship and sees the Punisher there too. They decide to team up. During the fight, Castle notices the ship about to blow up, so he pushes Daredevil into the water before it explodes with him on it. Meanwhile, Stick sends Jacques Duchamps to kill Elektra, but she kills him instead and then attacks Stick.
Daredevil arrives and breaks up the fight. Stick says he has his reasons for sending a man to kill her. Suddenly, Hand ninjas arrive and kidnap Stick. The two find him being tortured by Hirochi. Yoshioka explains to Elektra that she is the Black Sky, the leader of the Hand as written. They realize that it's the reason Stick wanted to kill her. Elektra doesn't give in though. The three of them fight the Hand and escape.
Page goes to Schoonover's house and meets Ray Schoonover there, Castle's old army general. Page puts together that Schoonover was working with the men from the docks, and that he is the Blacksmith. He notices, and kidnaps her at gunpoint. Castle, who survived, rams the vehicle they're in, and takes Blacksmith to the woods where he finds Schoonover's stash of weapons. He then kills Schoonover despite Page's pleads not to.
Back in the city, the Hand kidnap many people to lure Daredevil to them. These victims include Page and Turk Barrett. Daredevil and Elektra show up, but before going in, they decide that they will leave together and become lovers. Murdock admits that he has still loved her since she left ten years ago. They pursue Yoshioka on the roof top. Daredevil defeats many ninjas before the Punisher steps in and snipes the rest from a nearby rooftop. He then tells Daredevil he will see him around. Daredevil loses his ground and is about to get killed by Yoshioka, but Elektra steps in and gets impaled by his blade. Yoshioka looks in horror and he has stabbed the Black Sky. Daredevil angrily punches him to the edge and throws him over the edge, he then retracts his billy club to let him fall to the ground. He runs over to Elektra, who says that she loved being a hero like Murdock wanted, she then dies in his arms. Yoshioka wakes up, but immediately gets decapitated by Stick.
Many days later, Murdock and Stick reminisce over Elektra's life at her funeral. Murdock returns home and finally reveals to Page that he is Daredevil. Later, the Hand digs up Elektra's corpse and puts her into a sarcophagus effectively resurrecting her.

titulo: Marvel's Daredevil | Season 3 — Plot (wiki do MCU)
texto:
Matt Murdock wakes up in Saint Agnes Orphanage after nearly dying in the Destruction of Midland Circle. He is comforted by Maggie Grace, but panics as his senses are gone. As months pass by, Murdock keeps the truth about being alive from Foggy Nelson and Karen Page. Murdock, now a broken down man, finally gets his senses back and tries to fight crime again as the Man in the Mask. However, he is rusty and loses. As he's on his knees, he pleads the thugs to kill him, but they run when they hear the cops. Meanwhile, FBI Agent Ray Nadeem asks for a raise from SAC Tammy Hattley as his income is terrible, but she declines it. He goes on his weekly trip to get information from Wilson Fisk. Fisk only offers to speak if they keep Vanessa Marianna safe.
Murdock returns back to the church and is given a lecture by Sister Grace. He talks to her about how he has lost his faith and that he only has Daredevil left. Fisk works out in the prison gym, but suddenly gets shanked by Jasper Evans. He requests immediate release if he is going to keep giving information to the FBI because it makes him a target. The FBI agree to keep him imprisoned, but not in jail, in the Presidential Hotel. However, on the way there, his van gets attacked by Albanians. Fisk is saved by Agent Benjamin Poindexter. After hearing of Fisk's release, Murdock believes that people can't really change, just like Frank Castle said. He sees Nelson at a bar revealing he is alive. He informs the surprised Nelson that he isn't going back to his old life. He then leaves, having stolen Nelson's wallet to get ID into Rikers Island.
Murdock goes to see a prisoner named Michael Kemp. Kemp punches Murdock and tells the guards, bribed by Fisk, that he didn't say anything. Murdock is forced by the guards to get a concussion test. However, he is attacked by all of the guards and prisoners. He manages to get out with the help of the Albanians, who also hate Fisk. The Albanians tell Murdock that Evans was paid by Fisk to purposely shank him and is now out of jail. He then passes out in the taxi. When he wakes up, he finds himself being driven over the edge of the road and into the river.
Poindexter goes about his day, stalking a woman named Julie Barnes whom he had worked with previously. Murdock returns to his home and changes clothes but has to escape when Nadeem arrives to arrest him for his actions at Rikers. Nadeem finds Murdock's wet clothes and decides to pursue Page and Nelson as well. Meanwhile, Fisk asks his lawyer, Benjamin Donovan, for information on Poindexter. Donovan returns with recordings of psych meetings from Poindexter's childhood. Nelson, who doesn't like District Attorney Blake Tower, is convinced by Marci Stahl to start making a campaign to run for the position. Poindexter goes to Barnes' restaurant and mentions how he remembers her from their prior work. They talk for a while, but he accidentally reveals creepy information about her which causes her to run away. Poindexter returns to his apartment and freaks out, almost shooting himself, throwing objects, and throwing a knife at a picture of Barnes. He calms himself down by listening to recordings of the psych sessions.
Fisk opens up to Poindexter about his past in order to gain the Agent's trust. Poindexter joins him. Page also finds out about Evans and goes to see him to expose Fisk. There, she is attacked but saved by Daredevil. Page tells him to turn himself over to the FBI so that Page and Nelson are safe, Murdock accepts. Nelson, Murdock, and Page bring Evans to the New York Bulletin to expose Fisk with his truth. Suddenly, Poindexter walks in wearing a Daredevil suit and murders many employees. He then fights Murdock and defeats him before killing Evans and injuring Mitchell Ellison. The FBI arrive but they both escaped. Back at the Presidential Hotel, Fisk smiles as he watches the news saying that Daredevil killed many people at the Bulletin. He then has Barnes executed.
Murdock returns to the church, cut, bloody, and bruised. Grace tends to his wounds. He then meets with Melvin Potter who confesses that he was coerced into creating an identical Daredevil suit. Potter then surprisingly attacks Daredevil, saying that he is forced to keep Daredevil there until the FBI arrive. Daredevil talks him out of it, so Potter attacks the FBI, letting Daredevil escape, but is arrested. Nadeem meets with Page and Nelson as they were the only ones not effected by the attack. They tell Nadeem that Fisk had himself shanked. Nadeem then goes to see Fisk and asks him. Fisk's response makes Nadeem believe Page. At Nadeem's house, the agent goes to the basement to get beers when he is ambushed by Daredevil, who tells Nadeem that an FBI agent attacked the Bulletin.
The next morning, Nadeem does research and concludes that Poindexter is the most likely person. Daredevil and Nadeem go to Poindexter's apartment when he is gone. Daredevil finds the psych recordings. Poindexter suddenly arrives home and immediately notices something's wrong. He takes shards of glass from the chandelier to arm himself. The two men escape before the police arrive. However, Poindexter notices that one of the psych tapes are gone, so he burns all of them. Meanwhile, Page thinks that the best way to get Fisk away is to arrest him for past crimes. She visits Fisk and tries to get him to admit to killing his father, but he doesn't fold. To try to get him to reveal it, she tells him that she murdered James Wesley. Fisk goes to attack her, but she is taken away by FBI agents. Nelson tells her that he told the FBI she is trying to kill him because it's better that she gets away instead of being killed. Murdock returns to the church and starts boxing. However, he overhears Grace upstairs praying for God and Jack Murdock to watch over their son. Murdock falls to the ground when realizing that Grace is his mother.
Nadeem goes to SAC Hattley and Agent Winn to tell them about the Fisk conspiracy. However, Hattley kills Winn and tells the recording tape that Nadeem killed him. She then tells Nadeem that her and many others are coerced by Fisk, whom they call the Kingpin, and she will use that as leverage if he doesn't join them. Page escapes her apartment and stays at Clinton Church. Grace tells her that she hopes she can find Murdock now that he has left the church. He then goes around with many other agents including Poindexter as Daredevil to kill anybody Fisk wants. Daredevil enters the Hotel and goes to the security room where he finds a coerced woman. He hears over the radio that Fisk wants Page killed. The woman tells him that he has to kill Fisk now or else he might not have another chance. Daredevil tells her good luck and makes his way to the church.
At the church, Page witnesses mass from the hallways. Suddenly, Poindexter as Daredevil walks in asking for Page. Daredevil runs in and punches Poindexter. They fight, but Daredevil gets knocked down. Page, standing at the alter accepts her fate and closes her eyes as Poindexter winds up to throw his billy club. The stick makes contact, but with Father Paul Lantom who had stepped in front of Page. As Lantom dies, he asks Murdock to forgive him and Grace. Daredevil charges at Poindexter in a fit of rage. They make their way upstairs and the fight ends when Poindexter is thrown off the balcony and he escapes. Murdock and Page escape to the basement as the FBI agents enter. They talk with Grace and look for Daredevil, but are unsuccessful. Nadeem sees Lantom's body and becomes disgusted, so when Mahoney and his men arrive, he privately tells Mahoney to take Page or else they will kill her.
Kingpin orders the FBI agents to release him from custody, which they do. He then hears about Nadeem's actions and tells Poindexter to kill him. Nadeem knows what is about to happen, so he rushes home and gets his family out of bed. FBI agents invade his home and he shoots many of them. Daredevil arrives and attacks as well. When all of them are defeated, Daredevil says he owes Nadeem, he then reveals that he is Matt Murdock.
Now that Kingpin is out of jail, he reunites with Marianna and announces their marriage. Nadeem and Murdock go to see Page and Nelson. Nelson says that they have to try to take down Fisk the right way instead of killing him, so conclude that the best plan is to have Nadeem testify, so they call in Tower. Nelson makes a deal with Tower that he will drop out of candidacy if Tower can listen to Nadeem. After hearing the story, Tower says that Nadeem would have to be arrested as well for the things that he has done. Nadeem agrees and says that is okay. On the way to court, they are ambushed by Fisk's men, but manage to get to the courthouse. Upon arriving, Murdock uses his senses to notice that the jury has been coerced by Fisk. Therefore, Nadeem's declaration is ruled false. Nadeem returns home and records another declaration on his phone and sends it to his wife telling her to get it to Nelson. He then sits in his backyard as Poindexter approaches him. Poindexter draws his gun and kills Nadeem. Murdock believes that Fisk has to be killed now. They did it Nelson's way and now it's his turn.
The next morning, Daredevil calls Poindexter and tells him to go to a location and check a refrigerator. Poindexter complies and finds Barnes' corpse, frozen. Daredevil tells him that it was Kingpin. Nadeem's wife, Seema, goes to the FBI and asks for Nelson. She then shows him Nadeem's video. Nelson realizes that this is a dying declaration which means it will hold up in court, he concludes that he has to tell Murdock before he kills Fisk. Marianna and Fisk set up for their wedding. At the wedding, the Bulletin sends out Nadeem's declaration to everyone. As peers look on, they realize that Fisk is a murderer. Poindexter then arrives in the Daredevil suit and attacks Fisk. Daredevil intervenes and the three chase each other up to the penthouse and fight. Poindexter is thrown into a wall by Kingpin, rendering him paralyzed. Daredevil then duels Kingpin. He gets Fisk on his knees and punches him continuously causing his blood to spray onto the Rabbit in a Snowstorm painting behind them. Daredevil grabs Fisk's neck and prepares to snap it, but backs away, letting out a scream of anger. Fisk urges Daredevil to kill him, but he refuses saying that Hell's Kitchen is his city and he had beaten Fisk. He tells Kingpin that he will go to prison and not say a word or try to kill anyone or else he will go after his wife. Kingpin agrees to the terms. Mahoney then runs in and apprehends Fisk. The officers unmasks "Daredevil" revealing Poindexter, but Mahoney tells him that isn't the real one. He then points up to Murdock, who is walking out of the room. The next day, the trio decides to found a new law firm known as Nelson, Murdock & Page. Later, Poindexter is taken into surgery to fix his paralysis.

titulo: Marvel's Iron Fist | Season 1 — Plot (wiki do MCU)
texto:
Danny Rand returns to New York City fifteen years after a plane crash in the Himalayas killed his parents, the public believing Rand was also dead, but he was in K'un-Lun learning to fight. He later took the Trial of Shou-Lao becoming the Immortal Iron Fist whose purpose is to destroy the Hand. He walks into Rand Enterprises and sees his childhood friends, Ward and Joy Meachum, who don't believe he is the real Rand. He asked for their father, Harold Meachum, and they angrily tell him off, saying he died years ago.
Rand continuously tries to get them to believe it's him, but they eventually sign a restraining order against him. He gets injected with something by a Rand Enterprises guard that knocks him out, he wakes up in a mental hospital, strapped down to his bed. Rand is allowed to go to the phone and call someone. He decides to call Colleen Wing, a sensei whom he had briefly met earlier. Ward meets with someone who happens to be his father, Harold, who had died, but was resurrected by the Hand. Harold sends Ward to Wing to bribe her for a testimony against Rand. Meanwhile, Rand meets with a psychiatric doctor, Dr. Paul Edmonds, who soon begins to believe it's the real Rand.
Harold soon becomes intrigued and goes out to meet with Rand. When finding him, a confused Rand reveals he is the Iron Fist, destroyer of the Hand. Harold realizes this could be his way of getting free from the Hand's control. Joy, he also thinks it might by Rand, sends M&M's to him. When getting the package, Rand separates the M&M's, just like he did when he was a child. Wing thinks about the bribe and decides to visit Rand herself. Rand gives her the M&M's to give back to Joy. When she does, Joy breaks down in tears believing it's the real Rand. Wing doesn't sign the contract after seeing this. Later, Rand finds the strength to summon his Chi. He then breaks out with his Iron Fist.
Wing wakes up to the sound of Ward's guards breaking in to the Dojo. They ask Wing if they have seen the escaped Rand, but she denies it. After they leave, Rand drops from the ceiling, Wing tells him to leave in the morning. The next morning, they negotiate a deal to let Rand stay; however, he cannot go near the students. Later, Joy meets with Rand and gives him an offer, he gets one million dollars if he changes his name. Feeling betrayed, he tells her it isn't about the money, and declines. Rand then goes to an old friend, Jeri Hogarth, to help him get back into the company. Wing gets mad at her student, Darryl, for taking part in an underground fighting ring.
Later, Wing decides to take part in the fight herself and easily beats the bigger man. In a meeting with the company, Rand and Hogarth present an offer of 51% share of the company. Ward and the stockholders obviously decline, but Hogarth presents a pottery item that consists of Rand's fingerprint from his childhood. This proves that he is Rand, leaving the company no choice but to accept. Rand tracks Ward to the penthouse and meets with Harold again.
The next morning, Rand has a brief press conference before starting his first meeting. Later, Joy is attacked by hitmen. After defeating them, Rand finds out the man who sent them is Hai-Qing Yang. Upon confronting Yang, the man explains that Rand Enterprises backed out on their deal of the Red Hook Port. Rand explains that the Hand made them, the thought of the Hand makes Yang back away. Harold finds out that Joy got attacked and asks the Hand for a favor. They take him to Yang with a ninja mask on. He then kills one of Yang's gang members. Meanwhile, Ward finds the Hand's heroin and uses it.
Rand enlists Wing's help to go down to the pier and eradicate the Hand. They find a captive named Radovan Bernivig, who has been making heroin, the Hand's source of income. King tries to stop them and stabs Bernivig. They have no choice, but to bring him to one of Wing's students, Claire Temple. Temple stabilizes Bernivig who explains that the Hand has his daughter and are forcing him to make the heroin. Ward wakes up from his heroin to find a worried Joy. Meanwhile, Gao kills King for letting them go.
Rand decides to bring Ward to the pier to show him what the Hand is doing. When opening up a container, they find King's severed head. Ward decides not to call the police to avoid a scandal. Rand then finds a note left for him, which says to participate in the Da Jue Zhan in exchange for Bernivig's daughter, Sabina. Ward returns home to find his heroin is gone, so he goes into mental shock. As Bernivig's condition gets worse, Temple brings him to Metro-General Hospital. Suddenly, Bernivig is kidnapped by the Hand.
Rand pursues the challenge and encounters the Bride of Nine Spiders, who injects him with poison, he is then attacked by Scythe. However, Rand uses his Iron Fist to defeat Scythe. Before delivering a killing blow, Gao stops him saying she will kill Sabina if so. Gao lets Rand go with Sabina, but tells him she knew his father.
In his penthouse, Meachum is approached by Hand guards. He becomes unhinged and kills all of them. He then cuts off his own finger as punishment. Later, he tasks Ward with taking the corpses to the lake and dumping them. Rand goes to work and sees Gao in his office. She reveals that she has been in the company for a long time before leaving. Later, Rand infiltrates a Hand warehouse and finds an injured Bernivig, who apologizes and tells them the location of Gao before passing away from the torture. Ward goes to his car to find that his money is gone. He approaches Harold, who he suspects stole his money. After an argument, Ward decides to stab Harold to death, dumping his body in the lake after. He begins to get hallucinations of his father's murder.
Rand arrives at the penthouse and believes it was the Hand's doing. He promises to defeat Gao, but Ward just pushes him away. He, Wing, and Temple decide to surprise attack Gao at her facility. Rand approaches Gao and sees the guards are poisoned by the Hand. He recognizes the poison as the same poison that he saw on his parents corpses 15 years ago. He loses control and goes to punch Gao, but stops himself and captures her.
Harold wakes up in the lake, the Hand had previously given him the ability to resurrect himself. He returns to Ward with a knife, but instead hugs his son, and apologizes. Ward walks out and is stopped by cops, who say they found heroin in his car. Harold buys ice cream for his servant, Kyle, and thanks him. Kyle asks if there is vanilla, which there isn't. This makes the unhinged Harold angry and he beats Kyle to death. The trio interrogate Gao back at Chikara Dojo. Wing leaves the interrogation and slumps over holding her stomach. Rand arrives and sees Wing in bed. Wing reveals she is poisoned and asks Rand to call her master, Bakuto.
Joy is called into the penthouse where she sees Harold. She cries as she finally reunites with her father. Suddenly, Bakuto enters and tells Rand to heal Wing, which confuses him. Bakuto realizes Rand never finished his training. He shows Rand that he can use his Chi to heal. Rand centers his Fist near the poison and heals Wing, but is knocked out by energy he used. Bakuto takes him, Wing, and Gao to his facility.
In the morning, Wing and Rand wake up fully healed. Rand gets a call from Harold, which confuses Rand, but he dismisses it. Rand begins to feel something is wrong and looks around a forbidden area. He finds Gao in custody. Gao hints that Bakuto is the Hand, but Bakuto walks in and stops the conversation. Rand goes back to the room where he confronts Wing, who tells him that her and Bakuto are the Hand. Rand lashes out in anger, but Wing tries to tell him that the Hand is good and K'un-Lun fed him lies.
Later, Iron Fist begins to break out. He is then helped by his adoptive brother, Davos, who has been tailing him. Wing decides to help them escape as well, but runs off on her own. After, Davos tells Rand he came to bring him back to K'un-Lun to fulfill his destiny as the Iron Fist. Rand Enterprises shareholder, Lawrence Wilkins, walks into his office and is assassinated by Harold who plants evidence stating that Wilkins was the one that stole Ward's money.
Temple opens the door to Rand who is injured from the escape. She removes the blade from his stomach while he rants about Wing. After, Rand meditates on the rooftop and sees Wing approach him apologizing. He doesn't accept it, so she leaves saying there is no point. Wing meets with a Hand student, Becca Yoo, who ties her down and brings her to the blood sacrifice farm, saying she betrayed the Hand. Meanwhile, Rand and Davos go to the same facility to stop the Hand, but see Wing, who has escaped. Rand jumps out of his car to get to her. She tries to attack him saying she can't trust him, but instead Rand hugs her. Wing says that the Hand wasn't what she thought it was. Davos disappointingly walks away when he sees Rand hugging Wing.
Ward wakes up in a mental hospital, hallucinating. Bakuto greets him and says he can free him as long as he becomes head of Rand Enterprises because Harold has become dangerous. Bakuto brings Ward to the penthouse and turns on him, saving his men point guns at all three Meachums. He calls Rand and tells him he has thirty minutes to surrender himself, or Harold dies. Despite Davos' arguments, Rand surrenders himself just before Harold's death, but Joy gets hurt instead. In the elevator, the restrained Rand breaks free and is chased into the city. They stop at Bethesda Terrace where Wing prepares to duel her sensei. Davos tells Rand not to intervene. Wing eventually impales Bakuto, but decides not to kill him, as she is better than that. However, Davos runs in and kills Bakuto, this sparks an argument between Rand and Davos. The latter says that Rand is too weak to kill the Hand like he is supposed to, Davos then walks away. They turn around to find that the Hand has taken Bakuto's corpse.
Joy is brought to the hospital while Wing and Rand enter the dojo and kiss. They suddenly get a text from Ward telling him that Harold is coming. Men then break through the door and they realize it's the DEA. They are forced to flee. After meeting with Hogarth, they find out that Harold framed them for transporting drugs to South America. Rand decides to meet with Gao, who has information to prove his innocence. Gao instead reveals that Harold was the one that caused the crash that killed his parents. Harold was dying and made a deal to be resurrected, but Wendell found out, so Harold had him killed. Joy believes something is wrong and confronts her father, who lies, and she knows. Iron Fist arrives to kill Harold. The two exchange punches until Rand uses his Fist to punch the ground, sending Harold into a metal rod. Rand thinks the battle is over, but Harold frees himself and attempts to shoot Rand, but he blocks it with his Fist, Ward then arrives and shoots Harold, sending him over the edge of the building.
Ward and Rand cremate Harold's body to prevent a resurrection. Feeling betrayed by everyone for their lies, Joy arranges a meeting with Davos to destroy Rand and Ward. Gao listens in the distance. Rand decides to listen to Davos and return to K'un-Lun. He arrives with Wing, but finds dead Hand guards and blood. They then see that the gate to K'un-Lun is closed, leaving it's status to mystery.

titulo: Marvel's Jessica Jones | Season 2 — Plot (wiki do MCU)
texto:
In 2000, the Jones family is driving a car when Jessica distracts her father, Brian. This causes a crash that the public believes killed everyone, but Jessica.
Jessica's mother, Alisa Jones wakes up from a coma five years later to see Karl Malus and Leslie Hansen. They explain that the only person who survived is Jessica and she was given powers by Malus to survive. Malus did the same to Alisa. She tries to leave, but Malus explains that she has terrible mood swings and that Jessica believes she is dead. Alisa loses control and Malus sedates her. Meanwhile, Jessica is at a bar waiting for her adoptive sister, Trish Walker, to reveal her new hit song, I Want Your Cray Cray. She meets a man named Stirling Adams. Later, she finds Walker doing drugs so she tries to stop her sister, but it causes an argument. Jones decides to leave Walker.
Jones and Adams start a relationship. Adams wants to make a club called "Club Alias" and Jessica supports him. After some time, Adams pushes Jessica to make up with Walker. Jessica finds Walker, who is high. She gets Walker out and they talk. Meanwhile, Dr. Inez Green checks on Alisa, but Alisa jumps up, punches Green and kills Dr. Leslie Hansen before leaving. Jessica and Adams go to a bar, but Jessica leaves to use the bathroom. While she is there, Alisa trails her and finds Adams with his partners who are angry that the club hasn't started. The partners say they will forget about it if he gives them Jessica for muscle to which he agrees. Alisa sees this and confronts Adams who claims he just said that to get them off his back. Alisa then kills Adams. Jessica returns to find Adams on the ground, she yells for help and then hugs his body as police arrive. Alisa returns to Malus and understands that she cannot be out in the world. Jessica finds Walker and they make up.
In the present day, Jessica Jones returns to her Private Investigators Business and starts getting new clients due to her fame. She meets with a man named Robert Coleman or Whizzer, who claims to have super-speed despite his body not looking fit. He says that someone is trying to kill him. Another client, Pryce Cheng wants to buy out Alias Investigations for his own firm, but Jones rudely refuses. Meanwhile, Trish Walker does favors for people as Patsy in order to get a hospital file containing information on the death of the Jones family. Walker goes to Alias Investigations and gives a box to Jones. In the box is Jones' family's ashes. Jones tells Walker that she spent all this time getting over their deaths, she doesn't need more put on her.
Jones tries to dig up dirt on Cheng. Knowing Jones' tendencies, Cheng figures out that she is doing this and sends her all of his information himself. Jones then finds out that her client hired Cheng instead. She goes to Cheng's firm and announces that she found his client's missing dog. As Jones leaves, Cheng provokes her which prompts Jones to knock him over. He then takes out a taser, so Jones throws him through a glass door, but is surrounded by security. Later, Walker bails Jones out of jail. However, Jones is ordered to go to anger management. Walker goes to leave with her boyfriend, Griffin Sinclair, when she thinks she sees Will Simpson outside. She does a double take and sees that he is gone now. Meanwhile, Cheng hires Jeri Hogarth to represent him when he plans on suing Jones.
Jones returns home to find Whizzer still insisting someone is after him. He pulls a gun on Jones and then throws the box containing her brother's ashes at her. She deflects the box and chases him down the street, but she cannot keep up as he uses his super-speed. Suddenly, scaffolding falls on Whizzer and kills him. Jones returns to her apartment and simply stares off into the distance. Malcolm Ducasse comes in and cleans up the ashes. Jones looks in Coleman's bag that he left and finds a location of a laboratory. She reads the name and gets flashes of memories to when she was carried off by a scarred woman.
The next day, Ducasse finds out that the building Jones discovered was leased by Miklos Kozlov. Meanwhile, Hogarth finds out that she has ALS. Jones arrives at Kozlov's home only to find he got into a mysterious car crash and died. Later, detectives Eddy Costa and Ruth Sunday meet with Jones to discuss Coleman's death. They suspect she did it. Jones goes down to her superintendent, Oscar Arocho, whom she knows saw the accident and knows she didn't do it. He tells the detectives that he didn't see it, which angers Jones. Walker sits on the set of a movie when she hears a man walking towards her. She takes out a gun and warns the man, he reveals himself to be Simpson. Walker calls Jones who arrives shortly after. Jones accuses Simpson of killing Whizzer and Kozlov, but he refuses, saying that his new drugs allow him to keep control. Suddenly, the lights go out. Simpson tells them to run while he stays behind to fight the assailant. They soon escape, but find Simpson's corpse later.
After they dump Simpson's body in the ocean, they return to Walker's apartment. They hire a hypnotist to help Jones remember her past, but it doesn't work. Jones and Walker find a lead on the IGH case and find Leslie Hansen 's apartment. Jones returns home to find an eviction notice on her door. It is illegal to run a business out of your apartment. Jones goes to find dirt on Arocho. She finally does and realized that he helped fake someone's ID. She approaches Arocho who says that he can easily get around it with the police. Hogarth meets with Jones and asks her to find dirt on her associates because they are kicking her out of her firm. Later, Jones is able to get a meeting with Hansen. The meeting soon gets hostile when they talk about IGH and Jones says her family should've stayed dead. An angry Hansen displays powers similar to Jones and then runs away. Jones is able to get a quick picture of her jumping. Through the picture, Jones is able to find that Hansen is wearing a wig.
Jones returns to her apartment and finds Arocho's son, Vido. His son asks her questions and peers over the window sill of her room. He then loses his balance, but Jones saves his life as his parents walk through the door. To Arocho, it looks as if Jones to holding him over the ledge and angrily tells her she has 25 days to leave. Later, Jones meets Walker at a wig shop to find the seller to Hansen. They find a store and looks for more information off of what the owner gave them. When she returns home, Arocho enters her room. He apologizes and says that Vido told him what happened. He tells her that he dropped her eviction and gives her a bottle of whiskey. She invites him inside.
Jones and Walker's leads bring them to an old IGH doctor, Inez Green. They bring Green home with them when they find out she is in danger. Meanwhile, Cheng's friend, Nick Spanos robs Jones' apartment. Hansen catches him and kills him. Jones returns home to find out what happened. The police suspect she killed Spanos and arrest her.
The next day, Hansen feels bad for what she has done and burns her bloody clothes. She then calms down through playing the piano. At the precinct, Jones gives them enough evidence that the murders are Hansen's doing that the detectives release her. On her way out, Costa tells Jones that he trusts her because he was one of the cops that Kilgrave had mind controlled a few years before. Ducasse returns to his apartment to find both Green and his TV gone. He finds her in the street and takes her back. Meanwhile, Walker has been taking Simpson's drug: the Combat Enhancer Inhaler. Green talks to Jones and gives her the name, David Kawecki, a man who she believes was wrongfully convicted of Luanne McClure 's murder. Jones meets with Kawecki in prison to find that he is mentally challenged. Kawecki seems to love octopuses, so Jones asks him why. He says that Dr. Karl loves octopuses. Later, Jones goes to the aquarium and finds Dr. Karl Malus with Hansen at the octopus exhibit. They find Jones and Hansen hits the tank, causing a flood.
Jones returns home to find Arocho. Jones wakes up after sex to find that Arocho has been painting her. Jones goes out and finds more information on Malus. She then trails him to his house. She looks around the room and finds a picture of herself when she was younger. Confused, she turns around to see Hansen who explains that she is her mother using Hansen as a fake name. Alisa explains to Jessica why she hasn't been around. She explains what happened to Stirling Adams as well. Jessica hears this and punches Alisa. Malus comes from behind and sedates Jessica.
Jessica wakes up restrained to a bed. Jessica gets out and attacks Malus. She then lock herself in a room and sends a text to Costa with her location. Alisa breaks in and holds Jessica until Malus escapes. Alisa then waits with Jessica, planning to turn herself in and explains that the accident changed her appearance. Meanwhile, Green finds Hogarth's ALS medication and decides to help her. She brings her to her friend, Shane Ryback, who could heal people. Ducasse goes to a gay bar to dig up dirt on Hogarth's associate, Steven Benowitz, to help Jessica. As he walks out, he gets called homophobic slurs. He then gets beat up, but is saved by Walker who is on Simpson's drug. She explains that it will help him heal. He takes it, but immediately regrets it and runs away.
Jessica decides to help her mother and takes Alisa to her apartment. They stay there for a while. However, Cheng waits outside with a sniper. He shoots Alisa, but Jessica saves her. However, Jessica was grazed by the bullet. Alisa angrily charges at Cheng despite Jessica's pleads not to. Alisa catches Cheng and ties him up in Jessica's bathroom. As it turns out, Hogarth and Green are both gay and they sleep together. Hogarth then gets Ryback to stay with them to heal her more. Walker goes to Jessica's apartment. Jessica could tell that Walker is high on something.
Later, Alisa and Jessica talk when Arocho calls Jessica saying that his ex-wife, Sonia, took Vido. They chase Sonia down to a bus stop. They stop the bus and convince Sonia that her son wouldn't want a mother in prison. Meanwhile, Walker goes to take more of the inhaler, but finds that it is out. Jessica and Alisa return home to find Cheng waking up. Jessica talks to him in private and they agree to remain peaceful as they both have dirt that can take out one another. However, Cheng wants her to do something about Alisa. Jessica agrees and calls Costa who comes and arrests Alisa, who agrees to remain peaceful for her daughter.
In jail, Jessica tries to get Alisa to give up Malus' location, but she refuses. Alisa then starts talking about an old hotel that their family used to stay at. Jessica realizes that Alisa slipped up. Alisa is put in a cell with Dale Holiday as her guard. He starts abusing Alisa. Jessica arrives at the hotel and explains to Malus that Alisa will stay in jail if he is safe. She then takes a picture of Malus for a fake ID to get him out of the country. Jessica returns to Alisa to find out that Holiday has been abusing her. Meanwhile, Hogarth returns home to find out she got played. Green and Ryback stole all of her belongings. She breaks down crying. Jessica trails Holiday home and confronts him. He attacks her with pepper spray. She swings a staff at him, which accidentally kills him. She looks at the body in horror.
Jessica starts getting illusions of Kilgrave that she has created herself out of regret. He taunts her throughout the day. Jessica returns home to find that Malus is gone and so is Ducasse. They have been kidnapped by Walker. She realizes that Walker wants powers from Malus. Ducasse breaks out of Walker's trunk and scolds her. She shoots at his feet for a warning shot then leaves with Malus as a hostage. They go to a warehouse with equipment and Walker asks him to experiment on her. He starts the process, but soon Jessica arrives. She knocks out Malus and removes the equipment from Walker. Malus realizes what he has done and tells Jessica to run. He then shoots at the gas tank which blows up the building, killing him.
Jessica brings Walker to a hospital. With all the anger and stress, she yells at Ducasse for practically no reason. He decides to quit because she never treated him right. She then tells the illusion of Kilgrave that she isn't a killer, she can control herself. Kilgrave then disappears. Meanwhile, Alisa sees that Malus has been killed and Walker is the last person who saw him. She then breaks out of jail.
Alisa makes her way to Walker's hospital room and goes to attack her. Jessica, Sunday, and Costa stop her. Alisa then takes Sunday and holds her. She escapes by jumping out the window, taking Sunday with her. Sunday dies when she hits the ground and Alisa gets away. Costa warns Jessica to stay where she is while he checks on his partner. Walker then wakes up to see Jessica. Instead of being grateful, she calls Jessica an asshole for stopping the surgery. Meanwhile, Hogarth finds dirt on Ryback and goes to find Green. She brings Green outside. Green tells her that Ryback and her are in love, but Hogarth proves that he has been in love with many people and have stolen from them each time. Green then walks inside and shoots Ryback. Hogarth sits in her car and calls the police for a murder. Jessica finds Alisa at her apartment. Jessica points a gun at her mother, but hesitates. Alisa then knocks Jessica out, puts her in a car, and leaves the state.
Walker wakes up at the hospital and finds enough strength to leave. Jessica wakes up in the car and Alisa tells her that she hasn't tried to help her yet. Meanwhile, Ducasse fixes up Jessica's apartment as a final send off. He then confirms his appointment with Linda Chao, puts on a suit, and shaves his head. In the street, Alisa and Jessica notice a car crash. They save the family from the fire which makes Alisa feel really good and Jessica thinks there could be hope. Hogarth is at her home when Ducasse walks in. He explains that he tricked Chao into getting blackmail information. Hogarth uses this to win her firm back.
Alisa and Jessica arrive at Playland, an old amusement park that they used to go to. They get on a ferris wheel and talk. Alisa explains that she doesn't want any more harm for her daughter. Alisa called the cops to arrest her. She wants Jessica to leave and not see the cops come. However, Jessica chooses to stay. Suddenly, Jessica hears a gun shot. She looks over to see her mother collapsing. She jumps off the ferris wheel and finds Walker with a gun. She is about the kill Walker, but simply tells her to run. Jessica then walks back to the ferris wheel and sits next to her dead mother. Costa arrives and believes that Jessica shot Alisa herself. He comforts her.
In the days following, Walker tries to make up with Jessica, but to no success. As she walks out, she bumps into someone, causing her to drop her phone. However, she catches it with her foot and realizes she has powers. Jones walks by Ducasse without saying a word and arrives at Arocho's apartment to have dinner.

titulo: The Falcon and The Winter Soldier — Plot (wiki do MCU)
texto:
Six months after being restored to life in the Blip and being handed Captain America's shield by Steve Rogers, Sam Wilson is working with the U.S. Air Force overseas to rescue a hostage from LAF, a terrorist group led by Georges Batroc. Later, Wilson's partner Joaquín Torres briefs him about the anarchist group the Flag Smashers. Torres investigates Flag Smasher activity in Switzerland, only to be attacked by one of them during a bank robbery. Wilson, struggling with the mantle of Captain America, decides to surrender the shield to the Smithsonian Institution, and explains to James Rhodes that he feels like the shield still belongs to Rogers. But while he was helping his sister Sarah with the family business in Louisiana, the U.S. Government subsequently appoints a new Captain America: Captain John Walker.
Bucky Barnes, who had been pardoned by the U.S. Government, is outraged by the appointment and confronts Wilson on the matter, who defends his decision. Barnes tags alongside Wilson to Munich, where they encounter Flag Smashers shipping vaccines. While attempting to combat the group, they discover that the anarchists are all enhanced by a Super Soldier Serum, and are overpowered. Walker and his partner Battlestar arrive to help, but are also defeated. Despite being on the same side of the conflict, Wilson and Barnes refuse to work with Walker and Hoskins. Wilson and Barnes travel to Baltimore and meet Isaiah Bradley, a super-soldier of the Korean War who was imprisoned and used as a blood experiment by Hydra for thirty years before being released. However, Bradley kicks them out due to Barnes' presence.
Barnes is subsequently arrested for missing a mandated therapy session, but is freed by Walker.
